create_qwenimage_pipeline: create a QwenImagePipeline instance for text-to-image generation using pretrained Qwen-Image model
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode a text prompt into Qwen2.5-VL text embeddings with padding mask for image generation
generate_image_from_prompt: generate an image from a text prompt using the QwenImage diffusion pipeline with configurable steps and guidance
pack_latents_for_transformer: pack image latents into 2x2 patches for the QwenImage transformer input format
unpack_latents_to_image: unpack transformer latents back to spatial image dimensions for VAE decoding
